DFW’s Bathroom Remodeling Specialists

Serving DFW  · 85+ five-star reviews · Free estimates!

Golden Era Remodel is an owner-operated bathroom remodeling company serving the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, based in Mansfield, TX. Owner Anthony Brown personally manages and works on every project — from the first estimate to the final walkthrough.

Turn your bathroom into the retreat you deserve. We handle everything — custom vanities, tile, lighting, fixtures, and flooring — designed for beauty, comfort, and lasting quality.

Why DFW homeowners choose Golden Era

You work with the owner. Anthony scopes, manages, and is on site for the milestones — not a salesperson or a rotating crew.

Real tile, not acrylic. We build custom tile showers, not snap-in acrylic panels.

Waterproofing done right. Every shower is built with Schluter, wedi or goboard systems and real cement/epoxy grout, so it holds up for decades.

Clear timelines, no surprises. You get a detailed written estimate and a realistic schedule up front.

85+ five-star reviews from homeowners across Dallas–Fort Worth.

What Does a Bathroom Remodel Cost in Dallas–Fort Worth?

Most bathroom remodels in DFW range from $15,000 to $40,000, depending on size, materials, and scope. Here's a general guide — every project gets a detailed written estimate.

Secondary / hall bath: $14,000 – $28,000 · 2–4 weeks

Primary / master bath: $28,000 – $50,000 · 3–5 weeks

Luxury spa suite: $50,000+ · 4–6 weeks

Bathroom Remodeling FAQs

Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Dallas–Fort Worth? Most DFW bathroom remodels run $15,000 to $40,000, with luxury master suites higher. Secondary baths typically start around $14,000. We provide a detailed written estimate before any work begins.

Q: How long does a bathroom remodel take? Most secondary baths take 2–4 weeks; primary suites take 3–5 weeks, depending on scope and materials.

Q: Do you do custom tile or acrylic shower panels? We build custom tile showers — ceramic, porcelain, marble, and travertine — not acrylic panels. Every shower is waterproofed with Schluter systems and real grout.

Q: What areas do you serve? We serve the entire Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex from our base in Mansfield, including Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Southlake, and surrounding suburbs.

Q: Are you licensed and insured? Yes. Golden Era Remodel is a licensed, insured, owner-operated bathroom remodeling company.

Q: Do I have to move out during the remodel? Most clients stay home. If it's your only bathroom, we coordinate the timeline to minimize disruption.

Curbless & Walk-In Showers in Dallas–Fort Worth

A curbless, zero-threshold shower is the cleanest look in modern bathrooms — and the most forgiving for aging in place. But it's also the easiest to get wrong: get the slope, linear drain, or waterproofing wrong and you have a leak. Golden Era Remodel builds curbless showers correctly, with proper pre-slope, Schluter waterproofing, and precision tile. Owner-operated across DFW.

What's Included
Recessed/curbless floor with correct slope to a linear or point drain
Full Schluter waterproofing membrane and bonded drain
Large-format tile, mosaic floors, and custom niches
Frameless glass or fully open walk-in layouts
Comfort-height benches and grab-bar blocking on request
Curbless vs. Curbed — Which Is Right?

Curbless gives a seamless, accessible, high-end look but needs the right floor build-out; a low curb is simpler and contains water with less framing work. We'll tell you honestly which fits your home and budget — read our breakdown: Curbless vs. curbed showers.

What a Curbless Shower Costs in DFW

Curbless typically adds $1,500–$4,000 over a standard curbed build because of the floor framing and linear drain. Most full walk-in shower builds run $12,000–$25,000+ depending on tile and glass. See the cost guide.

Why Golden Era
We build the slope and waterproofing correctly — the part most installers rush.
Real tile and real grout, never premixed.
Owner-operated, 85+ five-star Google reviews across DFW.

Do curbless showers leak? Not when built right. The key is correct pre-slope and a fully bonded waterproofing system, which is exactly how we build.

Are curbless showers good for accessibility? Yes — zero-threshold entry is ideal for wheelchairs, walkers, and aging in place.

Can any bathroom be made curbless? Most can, but it depends on the floor structure. We assess this during your free consultation.

How long does it take? Most walk-in shower builds take 1–2 weeks; full bath remodels 2–4 weeks.

About Golden Era Remodel
Why We're Different

You work directly with the owner. When you call Golden Era Remodel, you're talking to the person who will actually be managing your project — not a salesperson who hands you off to a crew you've never met. That means clearer communication, faster answers, and someone who's personally invested in getting it right.

84+ five-star Google reviews. We didn't earn those reviews with slick marketing. We earned them by showing up on time, communicating clearly, delivering quality work, and treating every client with respect. Those reviews represent real DFW homeowners who trusted us with their homes — and we take that seriously.

Honest pricing. No surprises. We give you a detailed written estimate before any work begins. If something unexpected comes up during the project, we stop, show you what we found, and get your approval before moving forward. You'll never open an invoice and wonder where a charge came from.

Quality craftsmanship — every time. Proper waterproofing. Precision tile work. Clean finishes. These aren't upgrades at Golden Era Remodel — they're the standard. We don't cut corners because our reputation depends on every single project we complete.

Who We Serve

Golden Era Remodel serves two types of homeowners across DFW:

Golden Standard — Homeowners in Garland, Mesquite, Irving, Arlington, Grand Prairie, Carrollton, and Richardson who want quality craftsmanship at a fair, honest price. You've worked hard for your home. You deserve a contractor who respects that.

Golden Luxury — Homeowners in Frisco, Plano, Southlake, McKinney, Prosper, Keller, and Colleyville who want premium materials, flawless execution, and a finished space that truly reflects how they live.

Same standard of craftsmanship. Same owner on every project. The difference is in the materials and the scope — not the care.

Our Promise

Every project we take on comes with the same three commitments:

We show up. On time, prepared, and ready to work. Your time matters.

We communicate. You'll always know what's happening, what's next, and what to expect. No guessing. No chasing us down for updates.

We deliver. We don't consider a project finished until you're genuinely happy with the result. That's not a slogan — it's how we've built 84+ five-star reviews across DFW.

Ready to work with a contractor you can actually trust? Call or text us at (469) 586-6478 for a free, no-pressure estimate. We'd love to hear about your project.

Golden Era Remodel was founded by Anthony Brown to do one thing exceptionally well: bathroom remodeling. Anthony is on every job site, every day.

Frequently Asked Questions
What areas do you serve in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

We serve the entire DFW metro from our Mansfield base — including Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Southlake, Keller, Irving, Richardson, Garland, Mesquite, and surrounding areas across Collin, Dallas, Denton, Kaufman, Tarrant, and Rockwall counties. If you’re within about 45 minutes of Mansfield, we can come out.

How much does a bathroom remodel cost in DFW?

Most DFW bathroom remodels we do fall between $15,000 and $45,000, depending on the size of the space and the finishes you choose. A straightforward guest bathroom refresh with new tile, vanity, and fixtures is typically $15K–$22K. A full master bath with walk-in shower, custom tile, and stone work usually lands $30K–$45K+. We give you a detailed line-item quote after a free in-home consultation — no surprise fees mid-project.

How long does a bathroom remodel take?

Guest bathroom: typically 2–3 weeks once we start. Master bathroom with walk-in shower and custom tile: 4–6 weeks. Full primary suite with custom millwork or natural stone: 6–8 weeks. We give you a firm schedule up front and we don’t start until we have all the materials on hand.

Do you install walk-in showers and curbless showers?

Yes — walk-in showers and curbless (zero-threshold) showers are one of our specialties. We handle the waterproofing, linear drain installation, custom tile work, glass selection, and fixture install. Curbless showers require precise sloping of the subfloor, which is why homeowners hire us specifically for them — it’s not a job for a general handyman.

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. All in-home consultations and estimates are free, with no obligation. Most projects get quoted within 48 hours of the visit. Call or text (469) 586-6478 to schedule — evenings and weekends are fine. We’ll come out, measure, talk through your goals, and send you a detailed line-item quote.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — Golden Era Remodel is fully licensed and insured in Texas. We carry general liability and workers’ comp on every job. We’re happy to provide certificates of insurance on request before the project starts. We’ve been in business since 2020 with 85+ five-star Google reviews.

Do you handle everything or do I need to hire multiple contractors?

We handle the whole project in-house and with our trusted sub-trades — demolition, framing, plumbing, electrical, tile, cabinetry, counters, glass, paint, and finish carpentry. One point of contact (Anthony), one contract, one schedule. You don’t have to coordinate between a tile guy, a plumber, and an electrician — that’s our job.

Do I pick out my own materials or do you?

Both options work — whatever you prefer. Most clients want help picking, so we walk you through tile showrooms, cabinet options, and counter slabs. We have relationships with DFW suppliers that often get us better pricing than retail. If you already have a Pinterest board full of ideas, even better — we’ll help you turn that into a realistic, on-budget plan.

Will I still be able to use the bathroom during the remodel?

During demolition and installation the bathroom will be out of service. If it’s your only bathroom, we plan the schedule around you and work to minimize downtime. Most guest bathrooms are offline for 2–3 weeks; master bathrooms for 4–6 weeks. We keep the rest of the home clean with dust barriers and protect floors and walkways every day.

What kind of warranty do you offer?

We provide a 1-year installation warranty on our workmanship. If something we installed fails due to our craftsmanship, we come back and make it right. Manufacturer warranties on tile, fixtures, cabinets, and appliances come directly from the manufacturer and typically range from 1 year to lifetime depending on the product.

What happens if you find unexpected issues during the remodel (rot, leaks, old wiring)?

It happens on about 1 in 4 older-home remodels. When we find hidden damage — water rot behind tile, failed waterproofing, undersized wiring, old galvanized plumbing — we stop, photograph it, and get you a written change order before doing any extra work. You see the issue, you see the cost, you approve it. No surprise charges at the end.

What’s your payment schedule? Do you offer financing?

Payment is typically structured as a deposit at contract signing, progress payments at defined milestones (demo complete, rough-in complete, tile done, etc.), and final payment on completion. We accept credit cards, debit cards, checks, and NFC mobile payments. We don’t offer in-house financing, but we can point you to HELOC and home-improvement loan options most clients use.

How do I get started?

Call or text (469) 586-6478, or submit the contact form on our site. We’ll schedule a free in-home consultation — usually within a week. At the visit we’ll measure, walk through your goals, show you options, and get you a detailed written quote within 48 hours. No pressure, no obligation.

Bathroom Remodeling in Westlake, TX

Golden Era Remodel is a licensed, insured bathroom remodeling contractor serving Westlake, TX. Master bathroom remodels in Westlake estates typically run $40,000 to $90,000+, reflecting the home values, finish levels, and material expectations of communities like Vaquero, Glenwyck Farms, Granada, Terra Bella, and the Entrada district. Standard project timelines run 5 to 8 weeks for full master suites; secondary and guest baths run 3 to 5 weeks. You work directly with Anthony, the owner, on every Westlake project. Our 4.9-star, 85+ review reputation across DFW was earned by doing the work — not by selling it.

Why Westlake Homeowners Choose Golden Era Remodel

Westlake is one of the smallest and most exclusive towns in Texas, with custom homes that frequently top $3M, master suites that exceed many entire houses elsewhere in DFW, and finish expectations that match. The wrong contractor in Westlake means waiting weeks for a callback, designer markups stacked on top of trade markups, and "luxury" tile work that turns out to be a 21-year-old subcontractor on his second tile install of his life.

Homeowners choose us because:

Direct owner access. Anthony is on site for every milestone and reachable by phone or text in between. There is no project manager between you and the person actually responsible for the work.
Real luxury craftsmanship — not luxury marketing. Hand-detailed tile, book-matched stone slabs, frameless glass to within 1/16", precision-set thresholds, properly waterproofed systems with flood tests, and trim work that holds up to close inspection. The kind of finish that reads correctly in a Vaquero or Glenwyck Farms master bath.
We coordinate cleanly with designers, architects, and household staff. Many Westlake projects involve a designer or builder of record and an active household. We work with them, not against them, and we keep the home presentable through the project.
We handle the Town of Westlake permitting and the HOA architectural review. Vaquero, Glenwyck Farms, Terra Bella, and Granada all have ARC processes. We prepare submissions and follow them through.

Luxury master bath transformations with custom shower, freestanding tub, double vanities, and dressing area
Curbless wet rooms and steam showers
Custom tile and natural-stone installation (book-matched marble, quartzite, large-format porcelain, mosaics)

Smart-home integration (programmable shower, smart mirrors, controlled ventilation, lighting scenes)
Whole primary suite reconfiguration including closet integration
Guest suite and pool bath builds
Powder room jewel-box renovations
Coordination with designers, architects, and builders of record
Neighborhoods We Serve in Westlake

We work throughout Westlake, including Vaquero, Glenwyck Farms, Granada, Terra Bella, the Entrada district, the Quail Hollow and Mahotea Boone areas, and the homes along Dove Road and Solana Boulevard. We routinely cross into Trophy Club, Roanoke, Keller, and Southlake.

Westlake-Specific Considerations

HOA architectural review. Vaquero, Glenwyck Farms, Terra Bella, and Granada all have active HOAs with ARC requirements. Even when interior-only work does not technically require ARC review, we coordinate with the HOA on contractor parking, dumpster placement, and material delivery scheduling — Westlake HOAs are particular, and rightly so.

Town of Westlake permitting. Westlake has its own building permitting and inspection process. We pull permits and meet inspectors. Westlake inspections are thorough — we appreciate that, because it is consistent with the work we deliver.

Custom-build floor plans. Most Westlake homes are custom or semi-custom builds, which means there is no two-projects-the-same. Every estimate starts with a detailed walk and review of as-built drawings (when available) before we commit to scope or budget.

Stone slab lead times. Book-matched marble, quartzite, and exotic stone slabs often have 4-12 week lead times when sourced for Westlake-grade projects. We start slab selection at the same time we start design so material arrival lines up with the install schedule.

Coordination with household staff and family schedules. Many Westlake projects are in occupied homes with household staff, security, or active family routines. We coordinate access, gate codes, and daily start/stop times with whoever runs the home.

Pool bath / cabana bath: $20,000 – $45,000

Full primary suite reconfiguration: $100,000 – $200,000+

Every estimate is itemized and broken out by trade so you and your designer (if you have one) can see what is driving the number.

Recent Westlake Project Highlight

A 2008 estate home in Glenwyck Farms had a master bath that was finished to the period — heavy travertine, oversized garden tub, drop-down shower, and a vanity that walled off the natural light from the courtyard. We reconfigured the layout to open a sightline to the courtyard window, built a 6x10 curbless wet room with a freestanding cast-stone tub and a steam shower, installed a book-matched quartzite slab vanity wall, custom rift-sawn white oak millwork with hidden charging stations, heated floors, and a fully integrated smart-shower system. Seven weeks, coordinated with the homeowner's designer and household, finished within $400 of the signed estimate.

Do you work with our designer or architect? Yes. Many of our Westlake projects involve a designer of record. We coordinate selections, drawings, site visits, and decisions through them and copy you on everything that matters.

Are you accustomed to high-end finishes — book-matched stone, custom millwork, steam systems? Yes. These are the projects we do most often in Westlake, and we have the tile setters, finish carpenters, and steam/electrical specialists who do this work to the standard a Westlake home requires.

How do you protect the home during the build? Plastic dust walls with zippered access at every entry, ram-board floor protection over hardwoods and stone, HEPA air scrubbers running on demo days, daily clean-up of all common areas, and shoe covers for everyone on the crew.

How do you handle slab and stone lead times? We start slab selection in week one of design and confirm yardage and book-match orientation before deposit. Stone is ordered to the install schedule, not after demo.

Is the timeline realistic? Westlake luxury master baths run 6 to 8 weeks. Anything shorter from any contractor on a true luxury build is either a smaller scope or a quality compromise.

Why Colleyville Homeowners Choose Golden Era Remodel

Colleyville is the kind of community where homeowners stay for decades. Most homes are 1990s through early-2010s custom and semi-custom builds on half-acre to acre-plus lots, with master baths sized generously but finished to the era — granite tile counters, oversized garden tubs, frosted glass blocks, beige travertine. Our typical Colleyville client has lived in the home 10-25 years, the bones are still excellent, and the bath needs to come into the current decade with finishes that will hold up for the next.

Homeowners choose us because:

We design for "stay forever" — not flip resale. Most of our Colleyville clients are not selling. They want a bath that fits how they actually live: better storage, easier-cleaning surfaces, walk-in access, and finishes they will still love when their grandkids visit.
Direct owner access. Anthony is your single point of contact. No "production manager" filtering messages.

We pull City of Colleyville permits and handle HOA submissions when required (most of Colleyville's premier neighborhoods — Whittier Heights, Creekside, Cross Creek, Caldwell Creek, Saddlebrook Estates — have ARC processes).

Master bathroom remodels (full layout, custom shower, freestanding tub option, double vanities)

Neighborhoods We Serve in Colleyville

We are regularly in 76034 and cross into Southlake, Grapevine, Westlake, and Hurst on a weekly basis.

Colleyville-Specific Considerations

1990s–2000s builder construction realities. Many Colleyville homes were built in the 1990s/early 2000s by a small handful of regional builders. Common findings during demo: ABS drain piping (which is fine but does not always join cleanly to PVC additions), original Moen/Delta cartridge valves at end of life, undersized exhaust fans, and aluminum-coil neutral wires in master baths from late-1990s electrical. We document and address these as part of every quote.

HOA architectural review. Whittier Heights, Creekside, Cross Creek, Caldwell Creek, and Saddlebrook Estates have active HOAs with ARC processes. Interior-only bathroom work generally does not require submission, but anything visible from outside (vents, gas line moves) does. We handle the package.

City of Colleyville permitting. Colleyville has its own building permitting process. Permits are pulled in our name and we meet every inspector on site.

Half-acre+ lots and material staging. Colleyville lots are generous, which makes material staging, dumpster placement, and crew parking easy — but we still coordinate with you on where everything sits so the home looks like a home, not a job site, from the curb.

The garden-tub conversion. As in Southlake, the most common Colleyville master bath update we do is converting an oversized, never-used garden tub into a properly sized walk-in shower (often with a smaller freestanding soaking tub elsewhere). Done correctly, this is a major function-and-resale upgrade.

Every quote is itemized. You see fixtures, tile, labor, demo, plumbing/electrical, and contingency separately.

A 1998 traditional in Whittier Heights had the original master bath — beige tile, oversized garden tub the homeowners had not used in eight years, brass-trimmed glass-block shower, and a vanity layout that wasted a third of the footprint. We removed the garden tub, expanded the shower into a curbless walk-in with a low-profile linear drain, blocked the walls for future grab bars, installed heated floors under large-format porcelain, replaced the vanity with a custom dual-sink unit in painted maple with a quartz top, and added layered lighting on a single touch dimmer. Five weeks total, on the dollar of the original signed estimate.

Colleyville Bathroom Remodeling FAQs

Do you handle Whittier Heights / Creekside / Cross Creek HOA submissions? For interior-only bathroom work, ARC submissions are usually not required. When they are — exterior venting, gas moves, anything visible — we prepare and submit the package.

Can you do an aging-in-place layout without making the bath look clinical? Yes. Curbless showers, properly placed grab-bar blocking, comfort-height vanities, lever handles, and good lighting can all be done in a way that looks intentional and elevated, not institutional.

Will you replace the original cartridge valves and shower trim? On every gut project. End-of-life Moen/Delta cartridges from 1995-2005 are a maintenance liability and we do not re-enclose a wall over them.

How long does a master bath take? 4 to 6 weeks for most Colleyville master baths. Garden-tub conversions land in the same range.

Are you licensed and insured? Yes. Fully licensed for the trades that require it in Texas, fully insured, COI provided to your HOA on request.
